description:
Cali Clear Edibles

 

Cali Clear Edibles. Indulge your taste buds with Cali Clear Edibles featuring Sour Belts and Sour Rings. These delicious cannabis-infused sweets merge mouthwatering flavors with quality ingredients, offering a fun and enjoyable way to experience cannabis. With a dosage of 750mg per pack which is 75mg per piece. Each pack has 10 pieces and each carton has 10 packs.

Sour Belts

Cali Clear’s Sour Belts are a chewy, tangy treat that encapsulates the perfect balance of sweetness and sourness. Each belt is infuse with high-quality cannabis extract, providing a potent yet delightful experience. These edibles are perfect for sharing or enjoying on your own, making them ideal for any occasion.

Flavors: Available in various fruity flavors, such as strawberry, blue raspberry, and watermelon.

Effects: Each serving delivers a precise dose of THC, ensuring consistent effects that can elevate your mood and enhance your relaxation.

Sour Rings

The Sour Rings are another fantastic option for candy lovers. These gummy rings are not only deliciously tart but also packed with cannabis goodness. Their soft texture and vibrant flavors ensure a delightful experience with every bite.

Flavors: Enjoy an assortment of flavors, including grape, lemon, and green apple at 750mg.

Effects: Like the Sour Belts, each Sour Ring is carefully dose, providing a reliable THC experience that’s both fun and effective.

Why Choose Our Edibles?

Also, Cali Clear Edibles are crafted with care, focusing on quality and taste. Each product is made using pure cannabis extracts, ensuring a clean and enjoyable experience. The precise dosing allows for controlled consumption, making these edibles suitable for both new users and seasoned enthusiasts alike.

Conclusion

In summary, Cali Clear Sour Belts and Sour Rings offer a delicious and effective way to enjoy cannabis. With their bold flavors and quality ingredients, these edibles are a delightful addition to any cannabis lover’s collection. Experience the fun of Cali Clear Edibles and elevate your snacking today!
